title: Viracocha and Lake Titicaca as a mirror civilization of Lake Van
place_text: Lake Titicaca, Tiwanaku, Puma Punku, Bolivia/Peru

tellings.quote: Bolivia we have vosha holding the two Condors on either side which I think is the same concept you see in front of you of the pillars of holding balance

plain: At Lake Titicaca in Bolivia and Peru, near the ancient ruins of Tiwanaku and Puma Punku, there is a figure of Viracocha, a creator god of the Andes, holding a condor on either side. A researcher of ancient civilizations named Matt LaCroix says this is the same idea as the pillars "holding balance" found around Lake Van, a lake in eastern Turkey, and sees the two places as mirror civilizations. He gives it as his own reading, without naming a source, and if he is right it would point to a shared lost tradition on opposite sides of the world.
